model.name: NextageOpen
model.label: nextage
notes: expanded NextageOpen.urdf (a xacro template) with xacrodoc

backends.label: pinocchio
backends.name: pinocchio
settings: rigid rollouts: semi-implicit Euler on ABA with the shared timestep (no limits)

defaults.base: fixed unless a root joint (e.g. JointModelFreeFlyer) is passed
defaults.missing <inertial>: zero mass and inertia (the URDF specification)
defaults.mimic: independent joint unless built with mimic=True

backends.label: mujoco
backends.name: mujoco
settings: rollouts: contacts disabled; integrator left at the model default

defaults.base: fixed (the root link is welded to the world unless a 'floating' joint is declared)
defaults.fusestatic: true for URDF (bodies joined by fixed joints are merged)
defaults.velocity limit: not represented (MuJoCo has no joint velocity limit)
defaults.missing <inertial>: mass and inertia inferred from collision geometry (inertiafromgeom=auto)

warnings: MuJoCo cannot read ['.dae'] meshes: those collision meshes were dropped (this only matters for links without <inertial>)

backends.label: pybullet
backends.name: pybullet
settings: default joint velocity motors disabled (force=0)  [PyBullet holds every joint with a motor]
link linear/angular damping set to 0  [PyBullet's default is 0.04]
joint speed cap raised to 10000 rad/s  [PyBullet clamps joint speeds at 100 by default]

defaults.joint motors: a velocity motor on every joint, max force = URDF effort
defaults.mimic: not supported by loadURDF (the joint stays independent)

backends.label: pybullet[inertia_from_file=1]
backends.name: pybullet
settings: default joint velocity motors disabled (force=0)  [PyBullet holds every joint with a motor]
link linear/angular damping set to 0  [PyBullet's default is 0.04]
joint speed cap raised to 10000 rad/s  [PyBullet clamps joint speeds at 100 by default]

defaults.joint motors: a velocity motor on every joint, max force = URDF effort
defaults.mimic: not supported by loadURDF (the joint stays independent)

problems.headline: Engines simulate different mass, center of mass or inertia than the file declares
hints: PyBullet's loadURDF ignores URDF inertia tensors by default and recomputes them from collision shapes. Pass flags=URDF_USE_INERTIA_FROM_FILE (simcompat: -b pybullet:inertia_from_file=1).

findings.message: all joint axes are unit vectors
15 movable joint(s), all of supported types
